claim: Elastic Beanstalk is specifically designed for running web applications: it provides the runtime on EC2 instances, so you need to deploy just your application code.
question: Which service runs a web application on EC2 while you deploy only the code?

values.display: specifically designed for running web applications
values.spoken: Beanstalk is for web apps; you bring only code

evidence.quote: Elastic Beanstalk is specifically designed for running web applications. It provides the runtime on EC2 instances so you just need to deploy your application code.
